endpoints.description: Re-run the package install (pip/npm/pnpm) for an already-created Node.js/Python app.

Install Drupal on a domain via `composer create-project drupal/recommended-project` + `drush site:install`. Streams newline-delimited JSON progress events as the install runs (Composer project creation, database setup, drush install).
Uninstall Drupal: drops the database and user, deletes every file in the docroot, and removes it from Site Manager.
Clone this Drupal site to another domain (or subdirectory). Requires target_domain and source_db; returns a single JSON response.
Update Drupal to the latest version via drush. Streams newline-delimited JSON progress events, ending with {"status":"Update completed!","version":"..."} or an {"error":"..."} line.
Rebuild the Drupal cache via drush cache:rebuild. Returns {"message":"Cache rebuilt successfully."}.

Install Joomla on a domain by downloading the release archive from GitHub and running Joomla's own `installation/joomla.php install` CLI installer. Streams newline-delimited JSON progress events as the install runs (download, extraction, database setup, CLI install).
Uninstall Joomla: drops the database and user, deletes every file in the docroot, and removes it from Site Manager.
Clear the Joomla cache. Returns {"message":"Cache cleared successfully."}.

Install OpenCart on a domain by downloading the release archive from GitHub and running OpenCart's own `install/cli_install.php install` CLI installer. Streams newline-delimited JSON progress events as the install runs (download, extraction, database setup, CLI install).
Uninstall OpenCart: drops the database and user, deletes every file in the docroot, and removes it from Site Manager.
Clone this OpenCart site to another domain (or subdirectory). source_db is derived automatically from the site's config.php; only target_domain is required. Returns a single JSON response.
Clear the OpenCart cache. Returns {"message":"Cache cleared successfully."}.

Install Nextcloud on a domain by downloading the release archive from download.nextcloud.com and running Nextcloud's own `occ maintenance:install` CLI installer. Streams newline-delimited JSON progress events as the install runs (download, extraction, database setup, CLI install, trusted domain configuration).
Uninstall Nextcloud: drops the database and user, deletes every file in the docroot, and removes it from Site Manager.
Clone this Nextcloud site to another domain (or subdirectory). Requires target_domain and source_db; returns a single JSON response.
Update Nextcloud to the latest version via occ upgrade. Streams newline-delimited JSON progress events, ending with {"status":"Update completed!","version":"..."} or an {"error":"..."} line.
Clear the Nextcloud cache. Returns {"message":"Cache cleared successfully."}.

Install PrestaShop on a domain by downloading the release archive from GitHub and running PrestaShop's own `install/index_cli.php` CLI installer. Streams newline-delimited JSON progress events as the install runs (download, extraction, database setup, CLI install, admin directory rename).
Uninstall PrestaShop: drops the database and user, deletes every file in the docroot, and removes it from Site Manager.

Clone this PrestaShop site to another domain (or subdirectory). source_db is derived automatically from the site's app/config/parameters.php; only target_domain is required. Returns a single JSON response.
Clear the PrestaShop cache. Returns {"message":"Cache cleared successfully."}.
Install Flarum on a domain. Streams newline-delimited JSON progress events as the install runs (composer create-project, database setup, flarum install).
Uninstall Flarum: drops the database and user, deletes every file in the docroot, and removes it from Site Manager.
Clone this Flarum site to another domain (or subdirectory). Requires target_domain and source_db; returns a single JSON response.

Update Flarum to the latest version via composer require + flarum migrate. Streams newline-delimited JSON progress events, ending with {"status":"Update completed!","version":"..."} or an {"error":"..."} line.
Clear the Flarum cache. Returns {"message":"Cache cleared successfully."}.
Install Matomo on a domain. Streams newline-delimited JSON progress events as the install runs (download, extraction, database setup, CLI install).
Uninstall Matomo: drops the database and user, deletes every file in the docroot, and removes it from Site Manager.
Clone this Matomo site to another domain (or subdirectory). Requires target_domain and source_db; returns a single JSON response.
Update Matomo to the latest version via console core:update. Streams newline-delimited JSON progress events, ending with {"status":"Update completed!","version":"..."} or an {"error":"..."} line.
Clear the Matomo cache. Returns {"message":"Cache cleared successfully."}.
Install Moodle on a domain. Streams newline-delimited JSON progress events as the install runs (download, extraction, database setup, admin/cli/install.php).
Uninstall Moodle: drops the database and user, deletes every file in the docroot, and removes it from Site Manager.
Clone this Moodle site to another domain (or subdirectory). Requires target_domain and source_db; returns a single JSON response.
Update Moodle to the latest version via admin/cli/upgrade.php. Streams newline-delimited JSON progress events, ending with {"status":"Update completed!","version":"..."} or an {"error":"..."} line.
Purge the Moodle caches. Returns {"message":"Caches purged successfully."}.
Install MediaWiki on a domain. Streams newline-delimited JSON progress events as the install runs (download, extraction, database setup, CLI install).
